card.name: Reference-page metadata and version notes
card.fires_on: Punctuation and short words at the break between a function's description and its metadata line in software reference pages. Examples are version notes ("New in Version", "modified in"), "Minimum supported client", and "see Section" cross-references.

modes.label: Mathematica version notes
modes.description: Separators and words in the "New in Version 1; modified in 3" line that ends a Mathematica function entry.
modes.example: Related package: LinearAlgebra`Tridiagonal`. New in Version 1<<;>> modified in 3.

modes.label: Windows API requirements
modes.description: Words and spacing around the "Minimum supported client/server" table after a function note.
modes.example: Note This function is supported on Windows RT-based systems. <<Minimum>> supported client |Windows XP [desktop

modes.label: Section cross-references
modes.description: Opening bracket or colon before a "see Section" pointer or a parameter direction tag.

card.writes: Little clear output effect; it weakly promotes the word "usage" and a few stray symbols.
card.plain: It marks the point in programming reference pages where the description ends and notes on version, platform or cross-references begin.
